title: DAG topology executor (topo sort, multi-input/output stages)
description:
## Goal

Branching-DAG topology executor: topological sort, multi-input /
multi-output stage scheduling, build-time type-check via connector
typestate, runtime detection of cyclic / disconnected graphs.

## Context

Task under story `9e853c62` (Hybrid CPU+GPU executor) within epic
`gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Phase 0 design doc:
`dev/active/ec530af9-pipeline-design.md` §9 (graph API, `BuildError`
variants). Wave C.2 fan-out from `75c22fa8`.

## Deliverables

1. `crates/gf2-sim/src/executor/topology.rs`:
   - `TopologyExecutor::run(pipeline, scheduler, batch)` consuming a
     `Pipeline` graph and dispatching its stages in topologically
     correct order.
   - Multi-input fan-in: stages with k > 1 inputs wait on all
     producer scheduling before running.
   - Multi-output fan-out: a stage's output is referenced by k > 1
     consumers; the executor manages reference counting on the
     intermediate buffer.
2. Build-time type check: the graph API (`c09d3e95`) already
   detects type mismatches at `connect()`. This task verifies the
   typestate connector lineage at execution start (panic-free; any
   inconsistency yields a runtime error per design-doc §9).
3. Tests in `tests/dag_topology.rs`:
   - Linear chain (DVB-T2 BICM) → topo order matches the typestate
     preset.
   - Fan-out: a "double demap" graph (the same channel feeding two
     parallel demappers for diversity) — both branches execute in
     parallel.
   - Fan-in: two demapper outputs feeding a single decoder — the
     decoder waits on both.
   - Cyclic input → returns a typed error at execution; no panic.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Pipeline with fan-out / fan-in compiles via connector
  typestate and executes in correct topological order.
- [hard] Build-time errors: cyclic graph yields `BuildError::Cyclic`
  at `Pipeline::build()`; disconnected graph yields
  `BuildError::Disconnected`. Verified by `tests/build_errors.rs`.
- [hard] Multi-input / multi-output execution matches the expected
  semantics in `tests/dag_topology.rs`.
- [hard] `cargo-ci`, `code-review` gates green.

## Non-goals

- Turbo / feedback loops (epic non-goal).
- Cross-pipeline scheduling (out of scope).
